text: Decision: preserve scalafim's coherent basis-major ordering for multi-condition multi-basis event designs; do not mimic the current R fmridesign two-condition SPMG3 value/name mismatch. Added generated R fixture eventSpmg3TwoCondition and a parity test that normalizes the R fixture values from condition-major to basis-major before comparison, documenting the compatibility boundary. Verified: Rscript tools/r-parity/generate_fmridesign_r_parity_fixtures.R regenerated fixtures; sbt -no-colors designJVM/test designJS/test passed with 141 tests on JVM and 141 tests on JS.
